description: This file contains tests for color mode mixins in Sass, specifically testing the output of color mode handling via data attribute selectors and media queries. It includes test definitions that verify generated CSS code for dark mode.

methods.name: describe
methods.description: Defines a test suite with a description string.

methods.name: it
methods.description: Defines an individual test case with a description string.

methods.name: assert
methods.description: Sets up an assertion context within a test case.

methods.name: output
methods.description: Captures and outputs generated CSS from Sass mixins.

methods.name: color-mode
methods.description: A mixin that applies styles based on the specified color mode (e.g., dark).

methods.name: expect
methods.description: Defines expected CSS output for verification within tests.
